title: Keurameun nyang ka gadôh
intro: Kamoe meudong dikeue gema saboh masyarakat nyang kisah jih meutuleh lam gelombang. Jiwa-jiwa nyoe geudeungoe saboh panggilan, geupiléh peulawanan, dan geuhadapi saboh akibat nyang geubentuk lom bumoe. Soe awaknyan, dan peue nyang ka jeuet keu donya awaknyan?
clues: Geutanyoe udeb yoh masa ilée, dan teuka ubak geutanyoe sidroe utusan nibak lamkawan geutanyoe keudroe.
Kamoe seumah limong boh patong dan hana kamoetem tinggai patong nyan.
Kamoe peukém utosan nyan dan kamoe tudoh gobnyan sesat.
Kamoe meutuntut jih jiba hukoman meunyo jih beutoi.
Kamoe kalon langét jitron ujeuen dan bumoe jitron mata ié.
Kamoe ék u ateueh pucak-pucak nyang manyang keu kamoe peuseulamat droe, teuma kamoe jitiyeub lé umbak.

trial.label: Sidang/Acara
options: Kamoe ka lhom lam ie raya .
Kamoe mate le saboh beureutoh nyang kreuh .
Kamoe jipoh ngon batée nibak langét .
trial.answer: Kamoe ka lhom lam ie raya .

outcome.label: Hasee
options: Geutanyoe banmandum binasa keutjuali ureueng-ureueng meuiman ngon Nuh .
Kamoe meu ubah jeut keu kera .
Kamoe jitinggai sibagoe runtuhan keu ureuëng meujak .
Geutanyoe ka geu ubah jeuet keu sira .
outcome.answer: Geutanyoe banmandum binasa keutjuali ureueng-ureueng meuiman ngon Nuh .

arabic: قَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًۭا
verse: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss. (71:21)
